title: ✅ All 15 scenarios pass — soma primitive lifecycle hardened
summary: This PR hardens the soma primitive lifecycle by adding `on_shutdown` handlers to audio_client_bridge, tiago_camera, and tiago_lidar drivers, improving shutdown robustness. It also refactors start.sh scripts to log driver output and wait for process completion, and fixes the atlas endpoint rewrite in launcher.rs to use a helper method. All 15 Webots CI scenarios passed, covering builtin executors, camera/lidar snapshots, explore, mapping, memory, speech, voiceprint, and multi-step flows like object navigation and patrol observe.
pr_changes: Refactored tiago_camera/scripts/start.sh to log driver output and wait for process
Improved tiago_chassis/driver.py shutdown error handling and logging
Refactored tiago_chassis/scripts/start.sh to log driver output and wait for process
Refactored tiago_lidar/scripts/start.sh to log driver output and wait for process
Changed liaison listen address from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0 in robonix_manifest.yaml
Refactored launcher.rs to use `provider_atlas_endpoint()` helper and added unit test
Changed liaison listen address from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0 in init.rs template
test_result: All 15 scenarios passed: 4 builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, plan_control_builtins, run_command), 8 cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), 3 flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). Coverage includes 20 capabilities across executor, camera, lidar, mapping, memory, navigation, speech, voiceprint, explore, and scene.
suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor the new driver logging in start.sh for any unexpected output that could indicate issues.
risks_or_watchouts: The new driver logging in start.sh may produce large log files; ensure log rotation is in place.
The `on_shutdown` handlers are minimal (return Ok()); verify they are actually called during graceful shutdown.
The liaison listen address change to 0.0.0.0 may expose the service on all interfaces; confirm this is intended.
